claims.quote: Network pharmacology identified GRIN2B as a key hub target.

claims.object_text: bind to the same allosteric pocket as ifenprodil
claims.quote: Molecular docking revealed that β-asarone and senegenin (the active metabolite of tenuifolin) bind to the same allosteric pocket as ifenprodil on GRIN2B, sharing highly consistent interaction residues.

claims.object_text: upregulation accompanied by autophagic dysfunction (increased LC3B/LC3A ratio and PINK1, reduced p62) and mitochondrial stress
claims.quote: GRIN2B upregulation in AD mice was accompanied by autophagic dysfunction (increased LC3B/LC3A ratio and PINK1, reduced p62) and mitochondrial stress.

claims.object_text: β-asarone, tenuifolin, their combination, and YuanZhi decoction alleviate GRIN2B-linked autophagic imbalance and mitochondrial stress
claims.quote: β-asarone, tenuifolin, their combination, and YuanZhi decoction alleviate GRIN2B-linked autophagic imbalance and mitochondrial stress in AD-like mice, supporting their therapeutic potential.
